caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic watering can, rendered in grayscale. The can features a cylindrical body with a flat circular lid on top and a curved handle attached at the sides, arching over the top. A long, tubular spout extends diagonally downward from one side of the can; the tip of the spout is slightly flared and its interior is shaded dark. Attached to the back of the watering can is a large, flat, triangular fin that stands vertically. The metallic surface is illustrated with detailed texture, suggesting a slightly worn or aged appearance. The background is plain and unadorned, leaving the watering can as the sole focus of the composition. The artist's name appears at the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Jacking Torch
